name: ahp-desk
description: A desktop app for Agent Host Protocol hosts: the host list, ahpw or ahpapp in a window, and a bot on the desktop
author: Luiz Fernando Softov <lfs@softov.dev>

scripts.stage:all: pnpm stage:ui && pnpm stage:node && pnpm build:client
scripts.test: pnpm stage:all && pnpm -r test && cargo test --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml
scripts.lint: pnpm stage:all && cargo clippy --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml --all-targets -- -D warnings
